title: Zesty Saudi-Arabian Sausage Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy dish from Saudi Arabia featuring tangy white vinegar, sweet confit tomatoes, and snappy sausages.

ingredients.name: Confit tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Homemade confit or store-bought is fine.

ingredients.name: Paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked or sweet, whichever you prefer.

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb sausages, confit tomatoes, and onions onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, and black pepper.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sausages are nicely charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and brush with white vinegar.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
